title.target: Le Petit Manuel du cidrier amateur

author: Original nonfiction · AI-assisted
synopsis: A complete, approachable French handbook to cider making, from the apple tree to the glass. Twenty chapters explore growing and harvesting apples, pressing, analysis, fermentation, troubleshooting, blending, bottling, storage and tasting. Learn the craft and its vocabulary through practical explanations, careful observation and a little humour, with aligned English translations and contextual word lookups.
